players.product: AI data center power: sidecar (out-of-rack) power, in-rack power supplies for centralized and distributed architectures, energy-storage compensation; SST in development

connects_to.relationship: data-center power shelves and HVDC power systems for NVIDIA Blackwell and Vera Rubin platforms (NVIDIA-designated recommended data-center power provider)

contracts.signal: 2025 annual report: the company says it has become one of NVIDIA's designated recommended data-center power providers and is taking part in the innovative design and ecosystem building of data-center power systems and high-voltage DC power solutions for NVIDIA Blackwell and Vera Rubin series architectures; products it lists for NVIDIA platforms include a 33kW Power Shelf for GB200/300 and a 110kW Power Shelf for Vera Rubin (the 3RU 110kW Vera Rubin power system was at the validation stage).
